† [צָעַן] vb. wander, travel (Arabic ظَعَنَ journey, go away; prob. connected with Assyrian ṣênu, Ethiopic ጸዐነ:, Aramaic טְעַן, Palm. טען, all load (beast, etc.) = Heb. טָעַן †Gn 45:17; Aramaic טְעַן, ܛܥܰܢ also bear, carry);—
Qal Impf. 3 ms. יִצְעָן Is 33:20 travel, i.e. be removed, of tent (+ יִסַּע).
